title: Rabbi Abba of Caesarea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Taanit 15b, but the reading of the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim there is Rabbi Ada. In Moed Katan 20b he recited a baraita before Rabbi Yochanan, according to the reading of the She’iltot, Vayechi, the Rosh there and Dikdukei Soferim; the reading Hyman uses is Rabbi Ada of Caesarea. In Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:4: Rabbi Abba of Caesarea in the name of Rabbi Yochanan.

notes.text: The baraita-reciter role and Jerusalem Talmud locations are made explicit. The supplied names and attribution chains remain distinct.
